messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in 5xx/errors for inference-gateway (us-east1). Alert threshold breached at 02:03 UTC. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

sarah_ng: seeing ~18% 5xx on gateway for the last 10m, mostly 502/504. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/inference/gateway?from=-15m :eyes:

raj_patel: I see a concurrent surge of retries from the edge LB; retry attempts per request jumped. Could be retry loop or circuit breaker flipping. Logs: https://logs.redwood/inference/gateway?q=envoy%20upstream

lee: getting CPU at 90% on gateway pods, but upstream inference backends are showing healthy p95 latency. This smells like a proxy-level routing or retry policy.

emily_ops: @sarah_ng can you post the recent envoy config rollouts? any change in retry/circuit-breaker in last deploy?

sarah_ng: yes we rolled out lb-config v3.7 40m ago (traffic weight change + reduced circuit breaker thresholds). Diff here: `kubectl get cm lb-config-v3 -o yaml` -> pasted in infra channel.

raj_patel: pulling the config now. Found `retry_policy: attempts: 3` and `per_try_timeout: 2s` added to the route. Also `circuit_breakers: max_connections: 1000` reduced to 100. That could cause rapid tripping under surge.

lee: confirmed. The combination of aggressive retries + lower cb threshold can cause a thundering retry storm and 502s.

alice_se: customer-facing impact: error rate up for streaming gen endpoints and chat sessions. CS reported: several enterprise customers seeing session failures. Estimating ~6% of active sessions impacted in us-east1.

emily_ops: mitigation plan: 1) rollback lb-config v3.7 -> v3.6 (restore previous cb thresholds) 2) temporarily disable retries on gateway routes 3) scale gateway pods + enable burst capacity. Implementing 1 & 2 now, tagging @oncall-bot.

oncall-bot: On-call handoff: @raj_patel (pager) acknowledged at 02:07 UTC. Escalation to infra_sr if not resolved in 15m.

raj_patel: rolling back config to v3.6 now. `kubectl apply -f lb-config-v3.6.yaml` -> patching.

sarah_ng: applying config rollback. patch command output:
```
configmap/lb-config patched
deployment.apps/gateway rolling update started
```

lee: patching envoy route to `retry_policy: attempts: 0` as a hotfix on the gateway cluster to stop retry amplification. Applying via ingress proxy api now.

raj_patel: rollback triggered scaling event, pods are coming up. Healthchecks green.

sarah_ng: initial error rate dropped to ~8% after disabling retries, still above baseline but improving.

alice_se: notifying affected customers: sent interim notice to top 5 impacted accounts, CS on follow-up.

emily_ops: adding temporary circuit breaker bump to avoid flapping: set `max_connections: 2000` on prod route while we stabilize. Will revert post-mitigation.

raj_patel: monitoring tail logs. I still see periodic 502s originating from envoy->upstream 503s, but far less. Could be transient due to pod restarts.

sarah_ng: capture of envoy stats snippet:
```
cluster.inference_backend.upstream_rq_5xx: 1200
listener.0.0.0.0:8080.downstream_rq_5xx: 950
retry.upstream_rq_per_try_timeout: 430
```

lee: thanks. Looks consistent with retry timeouts causing extra load.

emily_ops: scaling gateway by +50% to reduce connection pressure. `kubectl scale deploy gateway --replicas=12` executed.

oncall-bot: action items logged in incident ticket INC-2026: rollback applied, retries disabled, cb thresholds increased, scale-up done. Page owner: @raj_patel.

alice_se: quick customer impact summary for ops/execs: - incident window 02:03-02:28 UTC (mitigations in-flight) - peak error rate ~18% - estimated 6% sessions impacted in us-east1 - no data loss, transient failures only - priority P1 for live mitigation and customer comms.

raj_patel: will keep monitoring for 30m. If stable for 20m, we'll mark mitigated and start a concise postmortem focusing on config rollout gating.

sarah_ng: follow-up: I'm adding a guard to the rollout pipeline to prevent reducing cb thresholds below safe baseline and to prevent adding retries without canary. Also adding an automated smoke test that simulates retry storms.

lee: note for postmortem: include load test that replicates client retries + backend latency to validate safe cb settings.

emily_ops: next steps: 1) keep config rollback for 1h 2) run a controlled canary with traffic shaping 3) doc update and runbook additions for retry policies.

raj_patel: error rate now stable at ~1.8% (baseline ~1%). Moving to monitoring-only. Will create postmortem doc and assign owners.

alice_se: thanks everyone — CS to send follow-up customer message with root cause summary when PM completes postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated at 02:28 UTC. Incident status: mitigated. All hands continue in follow-up channel for RCA.

sarah_ng: adding tags: `cause: lb-config-rollout`, `mitigations: rollback,retries-disabled,cb-bump,scale-up`, `severity: p1`.

lee: brief note — consider adding a circuit-breaker telemetry alert earlier (cb tripping rate) so we catch this pattern before 5xx climbs.

raj_patel: agreed. will add alert and link to runbook. Closing thread here, moving details to INC-2026 doc.
